name: SowChangeOrderManager
tagline: Change requests, client options and SOW budget control in one drop-in Power Apps component.
description: Log change requests against statements of work, assess fee, hours, schedule and staffing impact, offer the client options with margins, route large or low-margin changes for partner sign-off, capture client approval (also on a Power Pages client portal) and roll approved changes into the SOW budget – with work-at-risk and re-baseline warnings.
features: Fee, hours, schedule and staffing impact per change
Up to four client options with margin per option
Client approval with approved option and approver
SOW budget roll-forward and re-baseline threshold
Allowed status transitions, confirmations and undo
Phone layout with bottom view bar
controlType: standard (2 controls: SowChangeOrderManager data-set + SowChangeOrderManagerPortal field control)
